name: Graceland / Elvis Presley — 50th Anniversary 2027 Collaboration

company.name: Elvis Presley Enterprises / Graceland
company.description: Elvis Week 2027 and the 50th anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing; potential paid/licensed original artwork, premium collector edition, Graceland exhibition/unveiling, and optional charitable activation.

nextMove: Await Alicia Dean's response. If no reply, send one concise follow-up after 7-10 business days asking whether she can route the opportunity to the person overseeing 2027 anniversary collaborations/licensing.
strategicValue: Potential major music/cultural licensing collaboration with strong collector demand, Graceland visibility, premium edition revenue, institutional placement and access to the Elvis legacy ecosystem. Commercial structure must justify Keegan's studio time.
notes: Ioana Hall sent the initial outreach from ioana@keeganhall.com to Alicia Dean at adean@graceland.com on September 13, 2026. Keegan was not copied on the first email.

Opportunity trigger: Elvis Week 2027 is being positioned as a major 50th-anniversary celebration, creating an unusually strong lead-time window for rights, approvals, artwork development, licensing and premium collector production.

Keegan fit: established music subjects including Eddie Vedder and Dave Grohl; elite-client credibility through Michael Jordan and Rory McIlroy/Augusta National; most ambitious originals exceeding 800 hours; more than $850,000 raised through art-related charitable work.
Initial concept space: significant original Elvis artwork, 50th-anniversary collector edition, Graceland exhibition or unveiling, premium/VIP object, and optional charitable component.

Commercial guardrail: do not proceed as a default free-art donation. Preferred structure is a paid commission, guaranteed licensing/edition economics, sponsor underwriting, meaningful revenue participation, or another clearly defined strategic return before committing major studio time.

If Graceland is interested, clarify who controls the 2027 creative program, Elvis image/photo licensing, Authentic Brands involvement, edition rights, retail channels, pricing/revenue split, original-art ownership, launch timing, Graceland placement, press/content access and any charitable layer.

Authentic Brands is a likely downstream licensing stakeholder if commercial reproduction rights become relevant; do not contact both organizations in parallel unless Graceland directs the process or a response indicates licensing should move directly to Authentic.

Follow-up cadence: one follow-up around September 24 if no response. If still no engagement, avoid repeated cold outreach and revisit only with a meaningful new trigger such as announced 2027 partners, official licensing initiatives, exhibition plans or a warm introduction.

latestCommunication.summary: Ioana contacted Alicia Dean regarding the Elvis 50th-anniversary / Elvis Week 2027 opportunity, introduced Keegan's elite-client, music, craftsmanship and charity credentials, and proposed exploring a significant original, anniversary collector piece, Graceland exhibition/unveiling or other collaboration built around Graceland's existing 2027 plans rather than prescribing a fixed concept.
